description: A final class implementing SourceAddressPlaceholder that provides a singleton instance for resolving source address placeholders, supporting only a specific placeholder pattern '{{ source:address }}' in MQTT message contexts.

classes.name: ImmutableSourceAddressPlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable singleton class implementing SourceAddressPlaceholder used to resolve placeholders related to message source addresses in MQTT messages.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list containing the supported placeholder name '{{ source:address }}'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given name matches the placeholder support 'address', case-insensitively.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder with the input value if supported, returning an Optional containing the input.
